jobs.title: THE SINKHOLE · title page
jobs.prompt: a single full-page comic drawing (1 panel). Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. Series device: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white — but the line is not quite his. Palette: black and white. Page layout: title page: the masthead over a single image. Backup feature: THE SINKHOLE — a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for · found in Box 5 (weird), the title page: "THE SINKHOLE · title page". The page: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. not mine. keep. Panel 1: black and white newspaper Sunday comic section front in a brush line almost but not quite the strip's own, a florid serif masthead with a dateline drawn as blocks and a fold crease through it, a large circular section logo of a town street opening into a ragged hole seen from above with a riverboat tilting into it, columns of text drawn as gray blocks. lettering drawn on the page, exactly: "THE SINKHOLE", "a Sunday page from a paper he never drew for · found in Box 5", "not mine. keep.". Masthead: a newspaper Sunday-section masthead in a line almost his and not his: the title in a florid serif with a section number, a dateline drawn as blocks, a small circular section logo of a street opening into a hole, and the newsprint's fold crease running straight through the title. Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Any writing the description calls shapes, strokes or blocks is illegible marks, never real letters. Reference @chloe_17 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @gully_17 is the model sheet for GULLY: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @wood_20 is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Match the attached references: @chloe_17 for the character the strip's Chloe at 17; @gully_17 for the character the strip's Gully at 17; @wood_20 for the character Wood at 20-23.
